how_to: Record each answer with: cargo run --example voice_spike -- record <id>. Answer the prompt in your own words, as in a real round. Then type exactly what you said into "text" (keep fillers like 'um' out; keep repeated words in). The WAVs go to answers/, which is gitignored.

answers.prompt: Introduce yourself in one or two sentences.
How do you make a Kafka consumer idempotent when it writes to PostgreSQL?
When would you put Redis in front of PostgreSQL, and what goes wrong with cache invalidation?
Explain how an idempotency key works in a payments API.
Give the Big-O of two-sum with a hash map, and of sorting first then two pointers.
Estimate the storage for one year of payment events: say the rate, the size per event and the total.
Describe a latency fix you made, with the p50/p99 numbers before and after.
Name the people, teams and tools you worked with on your last project (e.g. Razorpay, Spring Boot, Grafana, Debezium).
Ask a short clarifying question about the input size and whether it can have duplicates.
Design a payment ledger: walk through it for 60–90 seconds, with natural pauses.
Explain the outbox pattern with Debezium and Kafka, 60–90 seconds.
Solve 'merge k sorted lists' out loud: think, pause, change your mind, as you really would.
Read out a few lines of Java: a method signature with generics, a for loop and a HashMap lookup.
